AMAZING: 🟠 Bitcoin confirmed 893,391 transactions on September 7, the fourth-busiest day in the chain's history, per Galaxy Research. That was 23.4% above the prior day's 723,854, and more than double the 441,035 printed on the same date in 2025. Galaxy put the reading above the 99th percentile of all daily counts since 2009, without naming a single app or cohort as the cause. CryptoQuant adds that nearly 80% of 2026 transfers are still under 0.01 BTC. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2097724464620355605

STRATEGY BUYS BACK $176.3 MILLION IN STRC, DOUBLES PREFERRED STOCK REPURCHASE PROGRAM TO $2 BILLION Strategy says it repurchased 1.81 million STRC shares between August 31 and September 7, while making no Bitcoin purchases or sales and issuing no shares through its ATM program. The company now holds 845,050 BTC, acquired for $63.73 billion at an average price of $75,412 per coin. Strategy also increased its digital credit securities repurchase authorization from $1 billion to $2 billion, with $1.19 billion remaining available. Its USD Reserve stands at $5.10 billion, with another $1.44 billion in USD Cash. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2097307881636860169

NEW: BLOCKSTREAM SAYS LIQUID NETWORK RESTART IS BEING PREPARED. Following the recent security incident and movement of funds, Blockstream says updated software has been deployed as Liquid Federation members prepare for a coordinated network restart. The company says its teams remain focused on further hardening the network and ensuring the return of assets. Blockstream thanked the Bitcoin community for its patience, support, advice, and assistance, and said further updates will follow. Source: https://x.com/bitcoinnewscom/status/2097129152306450529

HACKERS RETURN 3,400 BTC TO THE LIQUID FEDERATION ❗️ CONFIRMED. Block 965950, mined by Foundry. 3,400 BTC back in the Liquid federation wallet. Attacker keeps 598.5 BTC. 27 hours from the fork to the return. 11 rounds of OP_RETURN, PGP signatures, an Electrum tutorial and a mempool.space accelerator. All settled on-chain, in public, no lawyers.
